items.title: Phil Woods — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And everybody looked up and Khrushchev went [clap … clap] And the place exploded but they were all waiting for the chairman, you know, the boss, to nod his approval

ctx.x: Oh, yes. Well, here we are again with Phil Woods, June 23rd, 2010.
